query: SELECT n.kind,a.profile->>'display_name' AS actor,n.fields AS "fields: Json<Vec<String>>",t.key||'-'||i.number AS "key!",i.title FROM notifications n JOIN issues i ON i.workspace_id=n.workspace_id AND i.id=n.issue_id JOIN teams t ON t.id=i.team_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id=n.actor_id WHERE n.workspace_id=$1 AND n.user_id=$2 AND n.id=ANY($3) AND n.read_at IS NULL AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.created_at,n.id
